about_me: Dad of two little ones. I help in the preschool room during second service most Sundays. Looking for a few guys to actually go deep with, not just small talk.

Moved here for work in September. I grew up going to church but never really read the Bible on my own, and I feel a little behind the people around me. I'd like to start, with people who won't judge my questions.
Kids are grown and gone. I love hosting and I've walked alongside a lot of young moms over the years.
Two kids under three. Thursdays are the one night I can reliably get out.
Home with a toddler and a baby. Evenings are impossible with bedtime. A weekday morning with other moms would be a lifeline.
Mornings are the only time I can do anything. Looking for other moms of little ones and something that allows kids.
